links.outcome: SVM sepsis model AUC under simulated analytical biases in WBC, PLT, ESR inputs
links.effect: Original AUC 90.6%; across 26 bias conditions AUC ranged down to 87.8% for combined biases; no statistically significant differences (p>0.05), though bias can influence performance depending on parameters and combinations.
links.quote: No statistically significant differences were observed for AUC (p>0.05).

unlisted_practices: Assess the impact of analytical (laboratory measurement) bias on ML models using bias derived from analytical performance specifications

screen.reason: Empirically tests the resilience of an SVM sepsis prediction model to simulated analytical bias in laboratory measurements based on analytical performance specifications (APS).

primary.practice: stress testing for analytical measurement bias / sensor drift
